title: Creating Fighting AI Agents with Outlines!
author: fisj

comments.author: fisj
comments.body:
Disclaimer: I am not the author/creator.

This is a video about using "Outlines", a tool to constrain LLMs for structured text. It demonstrates how to create a RPG like interactive combat simulator. I saw this mentioned by the author on the Outlines discord. It aligns a lot with some stuff I've been researching on constrained LLM outputs.

[https://github.com/dottxt-ai/outlines](https://github.com/dottxt-ai/outlines)
